description: A moderate 5.6 km. hike following an old mining trail to a sub alpine ridge. An unmarked route continues to peak giving panoramic views of Skeena valley and surrounding ranges. Remains of mining sites can be found on the ridge.
directions:
Turn off Highway 16, east of Terrace, at Kleanza Creek Park. As you leave the highway do not go into the park but go to the left up the Bornite Mountain road (Kleanza Forest Service Road). At 4.5 km the access road turns off to the left.

This 8km road from the Kleanza FSR to the trailhead has been damaged by heavy rain and is not driveable by most vehicles. The road is narrow with few turnarounds and attempting to drive this road may result in having to back down a narrow road a long ways.

stats.Recreation District: Rec Dist - North Coast - Kalum - Cassiar

title: Bornite Mountain Trail
